__README: TEMPLATE — copy this file to deploy-config.json (which is gitignored) and replace every <...> placeholder with a value from YOUR environment. JSON has no comment syntax, so each section carries an '__example_*' key showing the SHAPE of the expected value; delete the '__example_*' keys (and this __README) in your real deploy-config.json if you prefer, they are ignored by the deploy. NEVER commit deploy-config.json — it contains account details, hosts, and passwords used during deployment.
__SECURITY: SENSITIVE FILE — deploy-config.json contains plaintext passwords. Restrict access, do not copy it into logs/tickets/build artifacts, and securely delete it when it is no longer required. Some demo deployment scripts pass database credentials through SQL*Plus and SSM command strings; before production, replace this mechanism with organization-approved secret storage and rotation, such as AWS Secrets Manager.

rbac.__comment: Required password for the non-production Cognito demo users created by the rbac stage. Choose a unique value that meets the Cognito user-pool password policy; do not reuse a production password.

email.__comment: SES sender must be a verified identity (domain or address). In SES sandbox the recipient must also be verified; demo_recipient is used when a customer has no email on file.

__comment_chart_bucket: S3 bucket for rendered chart PNGs; the agent returns a presigned URL (keeps WebSocket replies under API Gateway's 128KB frame limit). Reuses the agent artifacts bucket.
__comment_agentcore_memory: AgentCore Memory is NOT configured here — the 'agentcore' deploy stage creates (or reuses) it automatically and wires it into the runtime as AGENTCORE_MEMORY_ID.
